translatorNotes: Informal tú used throughout, neutral international Spanish.
No em-dashes used anywhere; the source's comma-spliced appositive style was kept with commas/colons in Spanish.

Meta platform/policy names kept literal: 'Business Partner', 'Meta', 'Business Partner de Meta'. Brand/platform names kept as-is: Meta, Instagram, Facebook, WhatsApp, n8n, Make, Zapier. Acronyms kept: DM, CRM, API, IA.
Currency localized in prose: '$1,000 and $5,000' -> '1.000 y 5.000 dólares'; 'low hundreds of dollars' -> 'unos pocos cientos de dólares'.

Terminology: comment -> comentario, DM -> DM, keyword -> palabra clave, flagged/banned -> marcada/bloqueada, lead -> lead, 'social media manager' -> 'community manager', 'X min read' -> 'X min de lectura', 'August 13, 2026' -> '13 de agosto de 2026'.

Internal same-site links repointed to /es (nav, breadcrumbs, footer, in-body /es/blog and /es/services links, /es/contact). Left unchanged: /privacy, /terms, sitemap.xml, mailto:, tel:, and external URLs (unsplash images, LinkedIn author profile, googletagmanager).
Language switcher added to nav (ES current, EN link to English post). English source received reciprocal EN/ES switcher and 3 hreflang alternates.

Article and FAQPage JSON-LD carry inLanguage 'es'; Article mainEntityOfPage @id and breadcrumb item URLs repointed to /es. author/publisher/image/dates/about labels left unchanged (about names kept in English as entity identifiers).
Asset paths changed from ../assets, ../css, ../js, ../favicon.ico to absolute /assets, /css, /js, /favicon.ico. gtag and og:image kept absolute.
